for f in root_test.go detail_page_test.go; do

for f in db.go cache.go queries.go; do
  cp "$SRC/insightsdb/$f" "$DST/insightsdb/"
done
for f in cache_test.go db_test.go queries_test.go; do
  cp "$SRC/insightsdb/$f" "$DST/insightsdb/"
done

mkdir -p "$DST/stringutil" "$DST/termstyle"
cp "$SRC/stringutil/stringutil.go" "$DST/stringutil/"
cp "$SRC/stringutil/stringutil_test.go" "$DST/stringutil/"
cp "$SRC/termstyle/termstyle.go" "$DST/termstyle/"
cp "$SRC/termstyle/termstyle_test.go" "$DST/termstyle/"

# Copy the command entry point
cp "$SRC/summary_cmd.go" "$DST/"
cp "$SRC/summary_cmd_test.go" "$DST/" 2>/dev/null || true
